name: launch-teaser
title: Launch teaser
summary: A 6-to-30-second teaser before a launch: a glimpse, a build, and the date. It promises; it doesn't explain.
use_when: Something is coming and the brand wants attention before it lands.

beats.name: glimpse
beats.job: A detail, a silhouette or a sound: enough to wonder about, never the reveal.

beats.name: build
beats.job: Rising tension, carried by the score and the motion.

beats.name: date
beats.job: When and where, in one line, readable without sound.

rules: Promise, don't explain: a teaser that shows everything is an ad.
One date or one call to action.
Teasing is still claiming: every hint stays inside the approved claims.

captions.position: inside the channel's safe zone for the aspect
captions.note: Square and vertical cuts use shorter lines (36 and 32 characters).

budget.note: Generation only when it's allowed and adds something.

notes: The end hold is the date beat at the shortest teaser, a quarter of 6 s (qa's end_hold): the films' 3 s end card would be half of it.
